format.description: Formatter rules applied by "Richdown: Format Document" and on save.

enabled.description: Set to false to turn this off for every file under this configuration.

default.description: Turn every rule not listed in "rules" on (true) or off (false). Without it, unlisted rules keep their built-in default.

ja-no-zenkaku-alnum.description: Japanese: convert full-width alphanumerics to half width (ＡＢＣ１２３ -> ABC123). Default: off.

ja-space-between-half-and-full-width.description: Japanese: remove ("never") or add ("always") the space between Japanese text and half-width alphanumerics. Default: off.

ja-punctuation.description: Japanese: convert punctuation to one pair, 、。 or ，．. Marks between digits, as in ３．５, are kept. Default: off.

ja-no-halfwidth-kana.description: Japanese: convert half-width katakana to full width (ｶﾀｶﾅ -> カタカナ). Default: off.

ja-symbol-width.description: Japanese: convert exclamation and question marks and parentheses in Japanese text to full width (！？（）) or half width (!?()). Default: off.

heading-style.description: Convert single-line setext headings (underlined with === or ---) to ATX headings (# Heading).

atx-heading.description: Put exactly one space after the # marks of a heading, remove its indentation and closing # marks, and add the missing space in a stand-alone line such as "##Heading".

list-marker.description: Use one marker for bullet list items.

ordered-list-numbering.description: Number ordered list items sequentially from the first item's number. Lists that use the same number for every item are kept.

table-format.description: Align table columns, counting East Asian wide characters as two columns, and pad short rows with empty cells. Extra cells beyond the header are kept as they are.

blank-lines-around-fences.description: Surround fenced code blocks with blank lines.

trailing-whitespace.description: Remove trailing spaces and tabs. Two trailing spaces that make a hard line break are kept.

consecutive-blank-lines.description: Collapse consecutive blank lines into one and remove blank lines at the start of the document.

final-newline.description: End the document with exactly one newline.

lint.description: Lint rules reported in the Problems panel and the Richdown editor.

enabled.description: Set to false to turn this off for every file under this configuration.

default.description: Turn every rule not listed in "rules" on (true) or off (false). Without it, unlisted rules keep their built-in default.

heading-increment.description: Heading levels should only increase by one level at a time. Default: warning.

single-h1.description: A document should have only one top-level (#) heading. Default: warning.

no-duplicate-heading.description: Sibling headings under the same parent should not share the same text. Default: warning.

no-empty-heading.description: Headings should have text. Default: warning.

heading-space.description: ATX headings need exactly one space after the # marks. Default: warning.

blanks-around-headings.description: Headings should be surrounded by blank lines. Default: warning.

blanks-around-fences.description: Fenced code blocks should be surrounded by blank lines. Default: warning.

blanks-around-lists.description: Lists should be surrounded by blank lines. Default: warning.

blanks-around-tables.description: Tables should be surrounded by blank lines. Default: warning.

fenced-code-language.description: Fenced code blocks should name a language, which Richdown uses for highlighting and Mermaid/Gherkin previews. Default: warning.

unclosed-code-fence.description: Fenced code blocks should be closed; an unclosed fence turns the rest of the document into code. Default: error.

list-marker-style.description: Bullet lists should use one marker. Default: warning.

ordered-list-numbering.description: Ordered list items should be numbered sequentially, or all use the same number. Default: warning.

table-column-count.description: Table rows should have as many cells as the header row. Default: warning.

no-empty-links.description: Links should have a destination. Default: warning.

no-reversed-links.description: Links should be written [text](url), not (text)[url]. Default: warning.

no-missing-image-alt.description: Images should have alternate text. Default: info.

no-broken-anchors.description: Links to #anchors in the same document should match a heading. Default: warning.

no-trailing-spaces.description: Lines should not end with spaces or tabs, except two spaces for a hard line break. Default: warning.

no-hard-tabs.description: Use spaces instead of tab characters outside code blocks. Default: warning.

no-multiple-blanks.description: Do not use more than one consecutive blank line. Default: warning.

final-newline.description: Documents should end with a single newline. Default: warning.

no-bare-urls.description: URLs should be written as links or wrapped in <angle brackets>. Default: off.

line-length.description: Lines outside code blocks and tables should not be longer than the limit. East Asian wide characters count as two columns. Default: off.

ja-no-zenkaku-alnum.description: Japanese: write alphanumerics in half width (ＡＢＣ１２３ -> ABC123). Default: info.

ja-space-between-half-and-full-width.description: Japanese: put no space ("never") or one space ("always") between Japanese text and half-width alphanumerics. Default: off.

ja-punctuation.description: Japanese: use one pair of punctuation marks, 、。 or ，．. Default: off.

ja-no-mixed-style.description: Japanese: do not mix sentences ending in the です・ます style and the である style. Only paragraph text is checked; headings, list items, tables, block quotes, and text in brackets are skipped. Default: off.

ja-no-halfwidth-kana.description: Japanese: do not use half-width katakana (ｶﾀｶﾅ -> カタカナ). Default: warning.

ja-no-zenkaku-space.description: Japanese: do not use full-width spaces (U+3000). Default: off.

ja-symbol-width.description: Japanese: write exclamation and question marks and parentheses in Japanese text in full width (！？（）) or half width (!?()). Default: off.
